page-description: Manage two-factor authentication and active sessions for your account.

enrollment.title: Two-factor authentication
enrollment.description: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the six-digit code it shows to confirm.
enrollment.forced-description: Your account must be protected with two-factor authentication. Set it up to finish signing in.
enrollment.codes-description: Each code works once if you lose access to your authenticator app. They will not be shown again.
enrollment.error-secret: Could not start enrollment. Please go back and try again.
enrollment.error-generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

management.description: Add a second factor to your account. After enrolling, signing in asks for a code from your authenticator app in addition to your password.
management.disable-description: Enter a valid authenticator or recovery code to disable 2FA. Your account will be protected by its password only.
management.regenerate-description: Enter a valid authenticator or recovery code. Your existing recovery codes will stop working.
management.codes-description: These are your new recovery codes. Each works once; they will not be shown again.

messages.error-generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
